# Knowledge and protocols

The corpus and the facts mined from it, protocol structure (signals, parameters, rules) with provenance, and checks that prose and IR stay faithful to both.

## Worked example

    ```python
    from flux_chia_nodes import flux_knowledge_lookup

    hits = flux_knowledge_lookup("bank conflict avoidance for strided access")
    for h in hits["results"][:3]:
        print(h["source"], "->", h["text"][:80])
    ```

Every chunk carries its source and license; the corpus is curated from
permissively-licensed material, never scraped (see the guidance the
[loop shape](../guide/loop-shape.md) page gives the mentor role).

## check_ir_protocols

Resolve every `protocol`/`model` reference in an IR document against the shipped protocol specs (docs/decisions.md D174).

| parameter | type | what it is |
|---|---|---|
| `document` | `dict[str, Any]` |  |

## check_prose_faithfulness

Cross-examine an authored artifact against the prose that requested it (docs/decisions.md D249) — the semantic half of prose-faithfulness (D240's backend capability table is the mechanical half).

| parameter | type | what it is |
|---|---|---|
| `prose` | `str` | The original natural-language request the artifact was authored from. |

??? note "3 optional parameters"

    | parameter | type | default | what it is |
    |---|---|---|---|
    | `objective` | `dict[str, Any] \| None` | `None` | Authored Objective IR document to check (or None). |
    | `design_spec` | `dict[str, Any] \| None` | `None` | Authored DesignSpec document to check (or None). |
    | `model` | `str` | `'qwen3.8:latest'` | Local Ollama judge model. |

## ip_catalog

Referenceable interconnect IP — crossbars, staged fabrics, Clos networks, butterflies, NoCs (docs/decisions.md D267) — with the rule that an entry is only listed if Flux can BUILD it.

??? note "8 optional parameters"

    | parameter | type | default | what it is |
    |---|---|---|---|
    | `interface` | `str \| None` | `None` | Filter to IP fitting an interface (`obi`, `axis`). |
    | `status` | `str \| None` | `None` | Filter by build status. |
    | `contains` | `str \| None` | `None` | Case-insensitive substring filter over the entry text. |
    | `instantiate` | `str \| None` | `None` | IP id to construct instead of listing. |
    | `clients` | `int` | `0` | Requester count (with `instantiate`). |
    | `banks` | `int` | `0` | Target count (with `instantiate`). |
    | `width_bits` | `int` | `0` | Datapath width (with `instantiate`). |
    | `params` | `dict[str, Any] \| None` | `None` | Entry-specific parameters |

## knowledge_lookup

Retrieve the top-`k` chunks of ingested spec/standard text matching `query`.

| parameter | type | what it is |
|---|---|---|
| `query` | `str` | Free-text search query. |

??? note "2 optional parameters"

    | parameter | type | default | what it is |
    |---|---|---|---|
    | `standard_id` | `str \| None` | `None` | Restrict results to one standard |
    | `k` | `int` | `5` | Maximum number of chunks to return. |

## list_protocols

Every protocol this build ships, with its source licence and whether that source is the standard or an implementation of it (docs/decisions.md D174).

## mine_knowledge

Mine typed, provenance-carrying facts from campaign and calibration stores (docs/decisions.md D243) — the Knowledge role learning from the Evaluator's own measured history.

??? note "3 optional parameters"

    | parameter | type | default | what it is |
    |---|---|---|---|
    | `campaign_db_paths` | `list[str] \| None` | `None` | Campaign store SQLite files to mine. |
    | `calibration_db_paths` | `list[str] \| None` | `None` | Calibration store SQLite files to mine. |
    | `facts_db_path` | `str \| None` | `None` | Optional FactStore file — persists the mined facts (content-addressed, idempotent; recall with recall_facts, D250). |

## protocol_lookup

Structured facts about a bus/stream protocol: signals with widths and directions, parameters, and the numbered rules of the source document (docs/decisions.md D174).

| parameter | type | what it is |
|---|---|---|
| `protocol_id` | `str` |  |

??? note "2 optional parameters"

    | parameter | type | default | what it is |
    |---|---|---|---|
    | `version` | `str \| None` | `None` |  |
    | `signal` | `str \| None` | `None` |  |

## recall_facts

Recall facts persisted by mine_knowledge's `facts_db_path` (docs/decisions.md D250): filter by fact kind (`estimator_bias`, `measured_point`, `observed_ratio`, `refusal_pattern`, `frontier_outcome`) and/or a case-insensitive substring of the statement.

| parameter | type | what it is |
|---|---|---|
| `facts_db_path` | `str` | FactStore SQLite file (written by mine_knowledge). |

??? note "3 optional parameters"

    | parameter | type | default | what it is |
    |---|---|---|---|
    | `kind` | `str \| None` | `None` | Optional fact-kind filter. |
    | `contains` | `str \| None` | `None` | Optional case-insensitive substring filter on the statement. |
    | `verify` | `bool` | `False` | Re-derive each recalled fact and attach its verification status. |
